text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove put her best foot forward in
the
Osaka Hai. Afterwards, in the
waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This race was another step towards
taking on
Suzuka. The question is, where
will she be next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Someone of Silence Suzuka's talents
would
probably run in...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. There's no doubt in my mind
that's where
she'll choose to run next.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That we will. I'll definitely defeat
Suzuka.
choice_data_list: 今日以上の走りを、『宝塚記念』で見せよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's show a run at the Takarazuka Kinen that's even better than today's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove begins to pack her things,
but
something seems off about her...
